SOUND / FORM — STUDY 001

A sound you can see.

Begin with Origin: a pure tone drawn as a single white line. Raise its pitch and the line becomes thicker. Add harmonics, noise, contour, and space to discover a more complex form.

The whole sculpture stays visible in silence. Playing the sound sends a light through it; delay leaves repeated impressions. Drag the sculpture to rotate it.

Connections define your own visual language. Drag or click between a sound parameter and a visual property. Select a line to adjust its strength, curve, inversion, and smoothing.
